dialogue.origin: （今晩は。宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.origin: （こんばんは、こちらこそよろしくお願いします）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. I'm looking forward to it as well.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。来ていただき、ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢・性別・ご相談内容を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 16歳、女性、最近1週間学校に行きたくなくて、昨日仮病して休みました
dialogue.content: I'm 16, female. For the past week, I haven't wanted to go to school, and yesterday I pretended to be sick and stayed home.

dialogue.origin: 教えていただき、ありがとうございます。そうなのですね。学校に行きたくなくてなやんでいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that. I see. You’re struggling with not wanting to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 嫌です、親にまだ言ってないし、気まずい
dialogue.content: I hate it. I haven’t told my parents yet, and it feels awkward.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…。親御さんにも言えなくて…。最近…、とは、何かきっかけ等ありました?
dialogue.content: I see... You haven't been able to tell your parents either... You mentioned this started 'recently'... was there some kind of trigger?

dialogue.origin: いじめられました
dialogue.content: I was bullied.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったのですね、ひどいですよね。
dialogue.content: That happened to you—that’s awful.

dialogue.origin: もし良かったら、状況等、教えていただけますか?
dialogue.content: If you’re comfortable, could you tell me more about what happened?

dialogue.origin: ある女に、呼び出されて、私の彼氏に手を出すなと言われました
dialogue.content: A girl called me out and told me to stay away from her boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: そのあとは、毎日嫌がらせのようにつきまとわれました
dialogue.content: After that, she's been following me around and harassing me every day.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったのですね。とても苦しいお気持ちだと思います。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: それは一週間前のことなのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: Did this start about a week ago?

dialogue.origin: 人間不信になる、
dialogue.content: It makes me lose trust in people.

dialogue.origin: 1週間くらい前
dialogue.content: About a week ago.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。相談者様に、何か心当たり等、あるのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I can understand that. Do you have any idea why this might have happened?

dialogue.origin: 隣の席の子が、たまたま方向が一緒で、声をかけられて、途中まで一緒に帰ってライン交換しただけ
dialogue.content: The boy who sits next to me happened to be going the same way, so he started talking to me. We walked partway home together and exchanged LINE contacts, that's all.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。それだけのことで…。呼び出された時、びっくりされたでしょうね。どんなお気持ちでした?
dialogue.content: I see. Just for that… You must have been shocked when you were called out. How did you feel?

dialogue.origin: 優しかったから、ちょっと好きになって、ラインしてたりして、学校でも話とかしてたら急に、色々されたので、びっくりだし、学校も嫌になりました
dialogue.content: He was kind, so I started to like him a little. We were messaging on LINE and talking at school, and then suddenly all this started happening. I was shocked, and I started to hate school.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね…。嫌にもなりますよね。怖いお気持ちもあったのでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I see... It's understandable you'd start to hate it. Did you also feel scared?

dialogue.origin: 人間不信ていうか、誰も信じないって気持ち
dialogue.content: It’s more like distrust of people—I feel like I can’t trust anyone.

dialogue.origin: 怖い気持ちもある
dialogue.content: I do feel scared, too.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…。人間が信じられなくなってしまったのですね…
dialogue.content: I see... So you've reached a point where you feel you can't trust people...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その一件を、先生か誰かにお話しされました?
dialogue.content: Have you spoken to a teacher or anyone else about this incident?

dialogue.origin: 言ってない、誰にも
dialogue.content: No, I haven't told anyone.

dialogue.origin: 言っても学校行きづらいし
dialogue.content: Even if I did, it would just make it harder to go to school.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。ずっと付きまとわれるのは怖いですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. It must be frightening to be followed around all the time.

dialogue.origin: 怖い
dialogue.content: It's scary.

dialogue.origin: それで今日は学校を休んでしまったのですね。
dialogue.content: And that’s why you ended up staying home from school today.

dialogue.origin: お友達にも話しずらい感じでしょうか?
dialogue.content: Does it feel hard to talk to your friends about it, too?

dialogue.origin: 昨日と今日も休んだ
dialogue.content: I stayed home yesterday and today, too.

dialogue.origin: 言えなかった
dialogue.content: I couldn’t tell them.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか…。誰かに言うと、ますますひどくなるかも、という思いでしょうか?どんなお気持ちでしょう?
dialogue.content: I see... Are you afraid that if you tell someone, things might get even worse? What's going through your mind?

dialogue.origin: そんな感じですもうこんな思いいや
dialogue.content: It's something like that. I’m so tired of feeling this way.

dialogue.origin: そのように追い詰められたような思いなのですね…。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you feel cornered...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どうしよう
dialogue.content: I don’t know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 嫌がらせをしてくる子は同学年なのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: Is the girl who is harassing you in the same grade?

dialogue.origin: 隣の席の子と知り合いなのかな?
dialogue.content: Is she acquainted with the boy who sits next to you?

dialogue.origin: 同学年
dialogue.content: Same grade.

dialogue.origin: 隣の席の子の彼女らしく、携帯見せ合ってるらしい
dialogue.content: Apparently she's his girlfriend. I heard they show each other their phones.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。では、相談者様が、隣の子に近づかなければ、被害はないのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. So, if you stay away from the boy next to you, would the harassment stop?

dialogue.origin: 四六時中一緒じゃないから
dialogue.content: They're not together 24/7.

dialogue.origin: 1人の時を狙ってやってくるのも怖い
dialogue.content: It's scary that she targets me when I'm alone.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。気が休まる時がないですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You must never get a moment's peace.

dialogue.origin: 隣の子、A君からも気にするなとメールが来たけど、もうラインも信じられないし
dialogue.content: The boy next to me, A, messaged me telling me not to worry about it, but I can't even trust LINE anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。ラインが信じられない…、とは、どんな理由があるのでしょう?
dialogue.content: I see. When you say you can’t trust LINE, what do you mean?

dialogue.origin: 彼女が見ている可能性があるから
dialogue.content: Because there's a chance his girlfriend is reading them.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。メールを見せ合っているのですものね。A君に、この一軒を相談したのですね?
dialogue.content: I see. Because they show each other their messages. So you did talk to A about this incident?

dialogue.origin: 向こうから、言われたので、話をしたのかと思いました
dialogue.content: He was the one who brought it up, so I assumed she must have told him about it.

dialogue.origin: そのようなことがあったのですね。
dialogue.content: So that's what happened.

dialogue.origin: もうどうして良いやら
dialogue.content: I just don't know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: A君について、相談者様はどのように見えますか?
dialogue.content: How do you see A in all of this?

dialogue.origin: ヘラヘラしてるなと感じました。あんな性格悪い女と、別れたら良いのにって
dialogue.content: I felt like he was just being flippant about it. I wish he would just break up with such a mean girl.

dialogue.origin: そのように思われるのですね。相談者様はちよっとA君に好意をもっいる感じでしょうか?
dialogue.content: That's how you feel about it. It sounds like you might have a bit of a crush on A, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい、でも、もういいです
dialogue.content: Yes, but... it doesn't matter anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。彼女に、ストーカーのようなつきまとい行為をやめて欲しいと、言えたらいいのですが…。
dialogue.content: I see. It would be good if you could tell her to stop the stalking-like behavior...

dialogue.origin: Ａ君に言ったら、言う事聞かないらしいんです
dialogue.content: A said that she apparently won't listen to him.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。今までにも、誰かに、彼女のようにきつい言い方で言われたことはあるのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see. Have you ever had anyone speak to you as harshly as she has before?

dialogue.origin: あります
dialogue.content: Yes, I have.

dialogue.origin: 以前にもそのような経験があるのですね。どのような時だったのでしょう?
dialogue.content: So you've had an experience like that before. What was the situation?

dialogue.origin: 学校の先生に、成績が悪くて怒られた
dialogue.content: A teacher at school scolded me because my grades were bad.

dialogue.origin: そんなことがあったのですね…。もしかしたら、その時のことがまた思い出されて、気持ちが沈んでいる感じでしょうか?
dialogue.content: I see… Do you think remembering that might also be weighing you down now?

dialogue.origin: それはないかも
dialogue.content: I don't think so.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、失礼しました。
dialogue.content: I see, my apologies.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: It's okay.

dialogue.origin: でもこのまま学校を休んでしまうと、どんどん行きづらくなってしまいますよね…。
dialogue.content: But if you keep staying home from school, it's just going to get harder and harder to go back, isn't it...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あまり休んでいると、先生や親御さんが心配されるでしょうし。
dialogue.content: And if you're absent too much, your teachers and parents will start to worry.

dialogue.origin: その彼女さんは同じクラスなのでしょうか?
dialogue.content: Is that girl in the same class?

dialogue.origin: はいそうですね親には言うことになりそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that’s right. It looks like I’ll have to tell my parents.

dialogue.origin: 彼女も同じクラス
dialogue.content: She’s in the same class too.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行っても、A君とは全く口を利かない、ということは出来そうですか?
dialogue.content: When you're at school, do you think you could completely avoid talking to A?

dialogue.origin: 付き合ってるとか知らないから、別に悪いことしてないと思ったら
dialogue.content: I didn't know they were dating, so I didn't think I was doing anything wrong.

dialogue.origin: 彼女の目が気になります
dialogue.content: But I’m worried about her watching me.

dialogue.origin: 別に私が悪いことしてない
dialogue.content: It's not like I did anything wrong.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。ずっと監視されているようで、辛いですよね。
dialogue.content: You're right. It must be painful to feel like you're being watched all the time.

dialogue.origin: どうしようかと
dialogue.content: I just don’t know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様がA君と関わらなければ、彼女さんもそのうち落ち着くのでは?
dialogue.content: If you don't interact with A, don't you think she might calm down eventually?

dialogue.origin: そうですかね？
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: 今は、怖い気持ちが強くていらっしゃるのですね。でも、A君に対して無関心を続けていけたら、そのうちやめるのでは、と思われます。
dialogue.content: Right now, your feeling of fear is very strong. But I think if you can continue to show no interest in A, she might eventually stop.

dialogue.origin: 隣の席ですが、、
dialogue.content: But he sits right next to me…

dialogue.origin: 目に入ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I can't help but see him.

dialogue.origin: はい、あえてA君も彼女さんも、見ないように努めてみてはどうでしょう?
dialogue.content: Yes, how about you make a conscious effort to not look at either A or his girlfriend?

dialogue.origin: ちょっと不自然ですが…。
dialogue.content: It might feel a bit unnatural...

dialogue.origin: 考えてみます
dialogue.content: I’ll think about it.

dialogue.origin: また、ご相談にいらして下さい。それでもダメなら、また一緒に考えましょう。
dialogue.content: Please feel free to come back and talk again. If that doesn't work, we can think of something else together.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうあ
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 時間になりましたので、これで終了させて頂いてよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.content: Our time is up now, so shall we end the session here?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、来ていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for coming.

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time.)

topic.sub: いじめに対する対処法
